rows.text: The U.S. Department of War is participating in the 2026 Marrakech Airshow (MAS) at the Marrakech Royal Moroccan Air Force Base, Oct. 7-10. The highlight of the American Airpower portion will be a dynamic F-35A Lightning II stealth fighter flyby, demonstrating the unmatched, integrated capabilities of the U.S.–Moroccan security partnership in North Africa.
rows.title: Sky-High Alliance: U.S. F-35s and Combat-Ready Wings Celebrate 250 Years of Friendship at 2026 Marrakech Airshow
